security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown links, fenced examples, placeholders, and sample creator handles. The confirmed issue is SKILL.md line 58, which instructs agents to run a local YouTube connector and use YOUTUBE_API_KEY. No prompt injection or covert exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the YouTube connector, and document that the target script must be trusted local code.
State that YOUTUBE_API_KEY must only be used for YouTube API reads, must not be printed, and should be omitted when unavailable.
Prefer package-local references, or clarify that parent-directory links are documentation links and not commands to scan parent folders.

content.value_statement: Influencer campaign results often sit across platform, creator, and sales data. This skill turns those inputs into ranked scorecards, attribution notes, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Scores campaign metrics against targets and benchmarks.
Compares platforms, creators, and content formats.
Reviews engagement quality, comment sentiment, and purchase intent signals.
Breaks down conversions by promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated methods.
Produces ranked learnings and next-step recommendations.
Provides fill-in analysis templates and worked examples.
limitations: Requires user-supplied exports, screenshots, or connected analytics data.
Does not perform dollar-level ROI calculations; it delegates that work to roi-calculator.
Significance claims depend on adequate sample size and benchmark quality.
The YouTube connector command needs local script availability and a YOUTUBE_API_KEY.

use_cases.title: Compare creator performance
use_cases.description: Rank creators by reach, engagement, conversions, and content quality after a campaign ends.

use_cases.title: Identify platform mix changes
use_cases.description: Compare Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other channels to decide where future spend should move.

use_cases.title: Prepare a post-campaign readout
use_cases.description: Turn raw campaign results into clear learnings, roster decisions, and recommendations for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze performance for this influencer campaign. Use the attached platform exports and summarize results against our targets.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators in one campaign. Rank them by reach, engagement quality, conversions, and renewal recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Find winning content patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review campaign posts across platforms. Identify the formats, hooks, messages, and calls to action that performed best.

prompt_templates.title: Build an attribution readout
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the campaign funnel using platform metrics, web analytics, promo codes, and sales data. Separate measured, user-provided, and estimated results.

output_examples.input: Analyze our spring skincare campaign with Instagram and TikTok exports.
output: Campaign score: 7.4 out of 10, with reach above target and conversions below target.
TikTok led engagement quality and assisted conversions, while Instagram produced broader reach.
Recommended action: renew the top creators and test more short-form tutorial content.

output_examples.input: Compare five creators from our launch campaign and recommend who to renew.
output: Top creator: strongest conversion rate, strongest comment intent, and clear product demo fit.
Middle performers: maintain at current spend while testing new hooks and posting windows.
Lowest performer: do not renew without a revised brief and clearer audience match.

best_practices: Provide campaign dates, platform exports, sales data, and targets before asking for final rankings.
Label each metric source as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Use the results with an ROI calculator when budget return decisions require dollar-level math.
anti_patterns: Do not treat screenshots and API exports as identical without checking timing and rounding differences.
Do not name a winner when sample size or lift is too small.
Do not use this skill as a replacement for full financial ROI modeling.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign dates, creator handles, platform metrics, web analytics, sales data, promo codes, targets, and benchmarks when available.

faq.question: Can it compare influencers?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks creators by reach, engagement, conversions, content quality, and renewal recommendation.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: It can organize ROI inputs, but it does not perform full dollar-level ROI math. Use the paired ROI calculator for that work.

faq.question: Can it use YouTube data?
faq.answer: Yes, if the local connector is available and the user approves using a YouTube API key.

faq.question: Does it support sentiment analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews comment sentiment, purchase intent signals, and engagement quality when comment data is provided.

faq.question: What is the final output?
faq.answer: The output is a performance analysis with metric scorecards, rankings, attribution notes, learnings, and recommendations.
